glossEn: the social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force; every opportunity, an obligation; every possession, a duty"- John D.Rockefeller Jr
note: the social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by moral or legal obligation。抽象的义务感。线索：a sense of duty / duty to do sth。

glossEn: work that you are obliged to perform for moral or legal reasons
note: work that you are obliged to perform for moral or legal reasons。具体的职责/值班。线索：on duty / night duty。与 s1 分界：s1 是「义务感」，s2 是「要干的活」。

glossEn: a government tax on imports or exports
note: a government tax on imports or exports。线索：customs duty / import duty。判别句：pay duty on imports（关税）/ off duty now（下班了）。
